CodBi_LDAP_AC_Mail.description: Apply to an XTextField representing an email address. Autocompletes from LDAP directory when the entered mail matches an LDAP entry.

CodBi_LDAP_AC_FirstName.description: Apply to an XTextField representing a first name. Autocompletes from LDAP directory (maps to LDAP givenName).

CodBi_LDAP_AC_LastName.description: Apply to an XTextField representing a last name/surname. Autocompletes from LDAP directory (maps to LDAP sn).

CodBi_LDAP_AC_Title.description: Apply to an XTextField representing a job title. Autocompletes from LDAP directory (maps to LDAP title).

CodBi_LDAP_AC_Department.description: Apply to an XTextField representing a department. Autocompletes from LDAP directory (maps to LDAP department).

CodBi_LDAP_AC_Telephone.description: Apply to an XTextField representing a phone number. Autocompletes from LDAP directory (maps to LDAP telephoneNumber).

CodBi_LDAP_AC_Account.description: Apply to an XTextField representing a username/account name. Autocompletes from LDAP directory (maps to LDAP sAMAccountName).

CodBi_LDAP_AC_CommonName.description: Apply to an XTextField representing a common name. Autocompletes from LDAP directory (maps to LDAP cn).

CodBi_LDAP_AC_DisplayName.description: Apply to an XTextField representing a display name. Autocompletes from LDAP directory (maps to LDAP displayName).
